community.reason: Level 2: current activities are employee development (named Leadership Edge, firmwide training, tuition assistance) plus student internships, with no current measured external education or community investment, so the employee-development cap of 2 applies.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: only workforce demographic statistics and general 'inclusive work environment' language are disclosed, with no specific inclusion or customer-access program.

ai.notes: Computed total: 0 + 12 + 4 + 9 = 25/100. Community and Cross-cultural coverage are marked insufficient, which triggers the sustainability-report second look. The human capital section is brief, and community investment appears only as a board committee oversight topic (E6) and a prior-year item. The $1.0 billion Visa-share contribution to the JPMorgan Chase Foundation (E5) was made in 2024, and the 2025 MD&A notes its absence, so it was not counted. Tax-oriented investments 'primarily in alternative energy and affordable housing' ($35.7 billion carrying value) were not counted as community investment: they are described as tax-credit investments, the affordable-housing portion is not separated, and the tie went to the lower level. The Conduct Hotline 'has translation services', but this is compliance infrastructure, so it was judged not to raise Cross-cultural above 1. 'Arts & Culture' appears only as a wholesale credit exposure subcategory (Leisure) and was treated as a trap for Creativity. Business Banking origination volume fell from $4.5 billion in 2024 to $3.2 billion in 2025. Also treated as traps: 'Consumer & Community Banking', the Community Reinvestment Act regulatory reference, 'stockholders' equity', and client fraud 'education and awareness trainings' (customer education).
